entities.summary: Michel de Souza Borges known as Michel Borges is a Brazilian boxer who won a silver medal in the 81 kg weight category at the 2014 Pan American Sports Festival. He competed at the 2016 Summer Olympics in the same category, but was eliminated in the third bout.
